sentences.text: No: for a UCB, the documents say penalty for default shall only be levied in the form of penal charges and not penal interest, so they do not state any maximum amount/percentage to add to the loan rate.
The documents state that no upper limit / cap for penal charges has been prescribed.
They also state that penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of loan contract.
The documents do not state any maximum amount/percentage for penal interest because penal interest is not permitted for a UCB.

missing.slot: maximum amount/percentage to add to the loan rate as penal interest
